aboutGreeting.title: Connecting a healthier tomorrow
aboutGreeting.body:
Welcome to CAREBASE Co., Ltd.

We help nitric oxide metabolite research meet daily life through products and solutions. We share verifiable materials and grow global opportunities with partners.

Thank you for joining us in building a healthier tomorrow.

no.title: What is nitric oxide (NO)?
no.text: Nitric oxide is a biological messenger related to blood vessels, circulation, and cellular signaling. CAREBASE studies this principle of nature.

metabolite.text: The metabolite platform is how we extend nitric oxide–related pathways into everyday solutions.
